summary: Minimal, correct fix: adds `isinstance(estimator, type)` so class objects (which have an unbound `get_params`) route to the deepcopy/error branch instead of calling `get_params()` without `self`. This is the canonical upstream fix; general (covers any estimator-type param, not just the reported one) and low-risk.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why the `isinstance(estimator, type)` guard is needed (classes expose an unbound get_params). Optional, non-blocking.
